issue.title: Bug: test_everflow_multi_binding_acl will fail due to the PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22949

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

test_everflow_multi_binding_acl will fail  on dual-tor AA caused by the PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22949

Becuase This PR changed setup_info from shutting down BGP on only duthost (one DUT) to using the shutdown_ebgp fixture which iterates over duthosts.frontend_nodes (all DUTs), but did not update restore_bgp to match.

please see code: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22949/changes#diff-9995c7b21f8c4bdfbce3afa16caea4605f218416c27cccb61a2c217efe259107L442

### Steps to Reproduce

run test_everflow_multi_binding_acl on dual-tor AA topology

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

test_everflow_multi_binding_acl fail due to the expected packeted are not received

resolution.title: Only shutdown ebgp on certain duthosts in everflow setup
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22949 switched to using `shutdown_ebgp` which shuts down ebgp on too many duthosts for certain topologies.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/23825

This change goes back to the old behavior and tries to reuse the code in `shutdown_ebgp`.

Summary:
Fixes #23825

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [x] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Go back to the old ebgp shutdown behavior in everflow before https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22949 but refactor some of the code in `shutdown_ebgp` to make it re-usable

#### How did you do it?
Factor out the common code out of `shutdown_ebgp` into `duthost_shutdown_ebgp` and `duthost_startup_ebgp` that everflow's `setup_info` can reuse

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran `test_everflow_ipv6.py` on a single-asic and multi-asic fixed box system and both passed.
